notes.title: Wanderlust: TMJ Demo 2.1 release
notes.notes:
Taking NextFest feedback into account, we've made several changes to the Wanderlust demo.

Shortened the length of the prologue section so characters are introduced quicker.

Removed unnecessary lines of text throughout all three chapters, that allows for better story flow.

"Voice" volume is now tied with the vocal beeps, and can be muted if the player wishes.

New name input screen to help avoid confusing/mismatch pronoun usage.

Removed ending screen and replaced it with simple text prompts
